title: Gateway federation PSKs are clonable and not zeroized on drop
description: P3 security review. New PskFederation in rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs stores the federation master secret in Vec<u8>, derives Clone, exposes it through psk(), and implements no Zeroize/ZeroizeOnDrop even though the gateway adds a zeroize dependency. Dropped/reallocated clones leave federation-wide authentication material in process memory, increasing disclosure impact. Store secrets in a zeroizing non-clonable wrapper, minimize raw secret access, zeroize temporary master_secret copies, and add compile/runtime coverage for secret lifecycle.
